description: Our team, InterstellarX, is participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Dancing with the SARs challenge. Our core motive is to build an automated pipeline using NISAR radar data to process multi-temporal Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery and track surface changes over time. By combining geospatial tools with machine learning, we aim to turn complex radar data into clear, actionable insights for environmental monitoring.
